subject: general
question: Which of the following human activities contributes to ozone layer depletion?

options.text: Using CFC-based refrigerants and spray cans

solution:
The correct answer is __**Using CFC-based refrigerants and spray cans**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs)**, used in refrigeration, air conditioning, and aerosol spray cans, are one of the primary contributors to **ozone layer depletion**. These compounds release chlorine atoms upon exposure to ultraviolet (UV) radiation, which then react with ozone (O₃) molecules, breaking them apart.
 
• The ozone layer is crucial for shielding the Earth from harmful **UV-B radiation**. Depletion of the ozone layer increases the risk of skin cancer, cataracts, and other health issues, as well as negatively impacting ecosystems and wildlife.
 
• CFCs were widely used in the 20th century due to their stability, non-flammability, and low toxicity. However, their negative impact on the ozone layer was discovered in the 1970s, leading to global efforts to phase them out.
